violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. FOOD THERMOMETER WAS ORDERED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit. EHS PROVIDED SOME BLEACH TEST STRIPS FOR USE UNTIL QUAT DISPENSER IS FIXED.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.PIC has a food handlers certificate.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.
